why: A wrong regex silently matches nothing and an extends chain is last-writer-wins, so the shipped preset must be generated from the table and every form must be proven to fire through it, not through the plugin directly.
what: New: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/preset.ts, generated preset files under packages/basalt-ui/configs/oxlint* , the generator packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-oxlint.ts (existing 2.x generator rewritten), the root .oxlintrc.json (dogfood, via make sync-self) and root tests/oxlint-preset-smoke.test.ts.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/guardrails.md section 6 (zones A E S V, profile table, roots), section 9 (pins, dependency stance), section 10 (preset), section 13 (smoke, fixtures). Roots follow manifest.roots (E6).
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-oxlint.ts, configs/oxlint-basalt.json, root tests/oxlint-preset-sync.test.ts and tests/oxlint-preset-routes.test.ts.
change: Generate the oxlint preset from RULES: jsPlugins basalt-ui/lint and @shadcn/lint, settings.shadcn, shadcn/no-restyle contracts (empty list until ui exists, fed by the generator once it does), overrides per root and per zone (E: no-restyle, primitive-bypass, app-spacing off in ejected paths; S: same, repo only; V: class rules off under **/components/ui/** at bridge). Profiles: tokens none; bridge = the five shadcn rules, no-restyle for the app's own components/ui only, ids 1-4, 6 (bridge forms), 14, 15; parts and app = all shadcn, ids 1-15. Exact pins oxlint 1.93.0, @shadcn/lint 0.2.5 written into the file. The smoke test builds a console-shaped temp project from the committed fixtures under test/fixtures/lint/{class,import-bypass,structure-rest}, applies the SHIPPED generated preset and runs oxlint. gen-oxlint --check exits 1 on drift. The root .oxlintrc.json keeps its ignorePatterns as committed (v3-test-roots edited them). The pins are read from package.json (v3-gr-1 owns them), never edited here. Also wire native oxlint jsx-a11y with settings.jsx-a11y.components generated from ui/*, and the oxfmt 0.78.0 sortTailwindcss preset. Rule: none new. Skill snippet: none. Test: tests/oxlint-preset-smoke.test.ts.
commits: One PR. Package commit: preset, configs, generator. Non-package commit: .oxlintrc.json via make sync-self and root tests/oxlint-preset*. Conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Preset smoke through the shipped generated file; seeded offender per form.
acceptance: bun packages/basalt-ui/scripts/gen-oxlint.ts --check exits 0, and exits 1 after one byte of the generated preset changes (test)
bun test tests/oxlint-preset-smoke.test.ts passes: every form in RULES has an invalid fixture that fires through the generated preset, and every valid fixture lints clean at its declared profile
The tokens profile yields no oxlint preset; bridge contains exactly ids 1-4, 6, 14, 15; parts contains 1-15
A mixed-root manifest resolves a different profile per file
The installed oxlint version equals the pin written into the preset
The generated preset sets settings.jsx-a11y.components for every ui/* export (test) and the oxfmt preset enables sortTailwindcss
out_of_scope: Weakened-config check (v3-gr-5), waiver codemod (v3-gr-6), hook, new rules, stylelint.
